target_customer: Parents of Spanish speaking children aged 4 to 15 in Latin America
problem: Parents in Latin America lack affordable, varied afterschool activities for children, especially during remote schooling.
business_model: Consumer subscription with a fixed monthly price for unlimited live classes
product_category: Live online afterschool classes for kids

founders.name: Gonzalo Aguilar
previous_startups: Check (curricular math platform for Latin American schools)
founders.background_notes: YC page says six years in K-12 ventures.

founders.name: Benjamin Garmendia
prior_employers: Check (co-founder and Head of Product, 2018 to 2020)
education: BA in Philosophy, Politics and Economics, University of Oxford (2015 to 2018)

technical_complexity.rationale: Live video class scheduling, catalog and subscription billing using existing video tools.

defensibility.rationale: Teacher supply and Spanish content help a little, but global marketplaces such as Outschool serve the same need.

market_need_then: Remote schooling in 2020 created demand for live classes; Dealroom says the platform served over 15,000 children in its early years.

branding.domain_note: Used prendea.com; the host did not resolve from this session.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or brand evidence found; search results confuse it with Prenda.

outcome_analysis: Prendea went through YC in Winter 2021 and is listed as inactive, with Dealroom saying it served over 15,000 children early on. No shutdown notice, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty. A plausible factor is the return to in person school, but no source says so.
notes: The seed round rests on one aggregator (Bounce Watch) with no amount, and it conflicts on location (Mexico vs Peru). Company site prendea.com did not resolve (DNS error), so it may be dead or blocked by the session network. No dated competitor source found; Outschool pages found were undated or from 2026.
